title: Reset a forgotten password
excerpt: Open the sign-in page and choose Forgot password. Enter the email address on the account and follow the link sent to it. The link expires after one hour, and a new link can be requested at any time.

title: Set up two-factor authentication
excerpt: Open Security settings and choose Add authenticator. Scan the code with an authenticator application and enter the six-digit code it shows. Recovery codes are issued once and should be stored safely.

title: Cancel a subscription
excerpt: Open Billing and choose Cancel subscription. Access continues until the end of the paid period, and no further charges are taken after cancellation.

title: Find an invoice or receipt
excerpt: Invoices are listed under Billing history. Each entry can be downloaded as a PDF receipt showing the amount, the date, and the payment method used.

title: Change the display name on a profile
excerpt: Open Profile settings and edit the display name field. The change appears to teammates immediately and does not affect the sign-in email address.
